description: Publish any local service, port, or directory on this node over Tailscale Serve (tailnet only) or Funnel (public; needs allow_funnel and confirm_public).

confirm_public.description: Required `true` for Funnel: acknowledges that the target becomes reachable by anyone with the link.

https_port.description: HTTPS port for the listener; defaults to the configured port. Funnel accepts 443, 8443, and 10000.

path.description: URL path prefix to publish under; defaults to `/`.

target.description: What to publish: a local port (`3000`), a loopback URL (`http://127.0.0.1:3000`, `https+insecure://localhost:8443`), or an absolute file or directory path.

authorization_url.description: Tailscale page that enables Funnel for this node, present only when authorization is required.

path.description: URL path prefix the route serves.

public.description: True when the route is reachable from the public internet.

qr_svg.description: QR code for `url` as inline SVG markup.

stage.description: `ready` when the route is live; `authorization_required` when Funnel must first be enabled for this node.

target.description: Local target the route proxies to.

url.description: URL to open: the published route, or the Tailscale authorization page when `stage` is `authorization_required`.
